decisions.quote: By mistake, a second data collection was carried out for one study16 replicating in stage 1; thus, we also include this study in the stage 2 results to base our results on all the data collected. This study16 does not replicate in stage 2.
decisions.reason: Although Ackerman et al. (2010) (main ref. 16, supplementary ref. 28) initially reached significance in Stage 1 (Supplementary Table 3), a second data collection was carried out by mistake and the authors explicitly base their final replication verdict on all pooled data collected, concluding that the study does not replicate in Stage 2 (Supplementary Table 4, p = 0.125, Rep. = no).
